biggest_catch: The friend's qualification details live behind the program disclosure link — the landing page confirms $50 each but not the transaction/direct-deposit requirements in full.
catches: Friend must meet the program qualifications (linked in the program disclosure) to trigger the payout.
Cap: up to $500 per year (i.e., 10 paid referrals).
Payout format is the program-described $50 reward; confirm exact form (cash/card) from program disclosure at build time.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: One Nevada Credit Union's official page (onenevada.org/refer-a-friend) runs a Refer-A-Friend program paying the referrer for qualifying referrals.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referrer earns $50 for each qualified referral, up to $500 per year (i.e., 10 paid referrals).

c3.evidence: Mechanism: enter the email associated with the One Nevada account to receive a personal referral link; share the link with friends/family by email, text, or social media; the friend uses the link to open a new One Nevada checking account and meets the program qualifications.

c4.evidence: Per the official FAQ: the referrer's $50 reward is emailed with redemption instructions after account requirements are met; the referred person receives their $50 after 60 days of becoming a member and meeting account opening criteria.

eligibility: One Nevada Credit Union members referring friends who open a new checking account via the referral link.
notes: Both parties earn $50. Program qualifications are in the linked program disclosure.
payout_quote: Earn $50 for each qualified referral, up to $500 per year.
payout_value_note: $50 reward per qualified referral as described in the program disclosure.

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: Referral link is free; no cost to refer.

s3.note: Tax treatment not disclosed on the official page.

s5.note: Offer live on the current official page (observed 2026-09-23); no expiration date is published.

s6.note: Referral mechanics stated on the official page: enter the account email to receive a personal referral link; share by email, text, or social media.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying actions: use the referral link to open a new One Nevada checking account and meet the program qualifications.

steps: Enter the email associated with your One Nevada account to get your personal referral link.
Share the link with friends/family by email, text, or social media.
Your friend opens a new One Nevada checking account via your link and meets the qualifications.
You earn $50 (up to $500/year); your $50 is emailed to you, your friend gets $50 after 60 days.
timing: The referrer's $50 reward is emailed with redemption instructions after account requirements are met; the referred friend receives $50 after 60 days of membership.
weasel_words: Friend-side qualification details are in the linked program disclosure rather than on the landing page; core payout and cap are explicit.
